name: Air Hockey
hook: One puck, real bounces, first to 7.
how: Move your paddle with the mouse or a finger and smack the puck into the other goal. Each of you sees the table from your own end. Alone, you play a bot; a third person watches and plays the winner.
uses: One player's browser moves the puck and keeps the score, so both players see the same bounce; if it leaves, the other player takes over.
A bot plays the other paddle until a friend joins.
Both paddles and the puck move for everyone at once.
ideas: Add a second puck after each goal
Make it four players, one on each side
Add a power-up that shrinks the other goal
